investigation_notes.Recent Similar Alert: SOC-12550 closed as FP; user confirmed planned holiday in Tokyo until Feb 2nd.
investigation_notes.Description: An elevated volume of SharePoint downloads (250 vs a 24-hour baseline of 30) was observed from the user's endpoint, but the downloaded files and paths are directly related to architecture project work. The activity originated from Tokyo and occurred at 08:20 local time, which aligns with normal working hours, and the user's role as Principal Structural Architect provides a plausible business reason for accessing these files. A recent similar alert from the same endpoint was closed after the user confirmed presence in Tokyo, which corroborates this activity as authorized; therefore the event is assessed as low priority.
